tests/test_own_account_pairing.py:_p11_structure checks that each pair is one debit and one credit of equal pence in different accounts within the days, each naming the other (so no line is in two pairs). test_p11_generated_cases_pair_moves_and_leave_outside_money[0-11] checks M17-M19 == outside credits. All 20 p11 tests PASSED in invariants-5.log. The property is proven only on generated cases whose outside amounts never coincide with a move's (see finding).

findings.claim: P11's 'for any multi-account case' is proven only on cases whose generator draws every amount distinct except a move's two halves, so the test never meets an outside credit equal in amount to a debit in another account. On such a case the code (per R8's literal text) pairs them as an own-account transfer, and total money in less own-account transfers in no longer equals the credits from outside. This is a spec tension between R8 and P11 that the test sidesteps rather than exposes.
findings.repro: Two-account case: main has 'DD COUNCIL' -50.00 on 2026-03-02; savings has 'CARD SETTLEMENT STRIPE' +50.00 on 2026-03-04 and no other inflow. overrides.case_figures pairs main's debit with savings' credit (both rule pairing:...). Combined M17-M19 = 0 while the outside credit is 50.00, violating P11's third clause.
